name: Kann
notes: First restaurant in the world to serve Wildtype's FDA-cleared cultivated salmon; on the menu daily since July 2025.

name: barmini by José Andrés
notes: Part of Wildtype's post-FDA-approval restaurant expansion in 2025.

name: The Walrus and the Carpenter
notes: Ballard oyster bar serving Wildtype cultivated salmon as part of the 2025 expansion.

name: Kingfisher Bar & Grill
notes: First Tucson restaurant to serve lab-grown salmon; smoked-salmon preparation with vegan cream cheese.

name: Huber's Butchery & Bistro
notes: Sells GOOD Meat-3 (hybrid: ~3% cultivated chicken cells + plant-based) frozen at retail, and serves cultivated chicken dishes in the attached bistro.

name: Bar Crenn
notes: One of the first two US restaurants to sell cultivated chicken (2023). Dominique Crenn's dinner series ended; chicken no longer on the menu here.

name: China Chilcano
notes: José Andrés' restaurant was one of the first two US spots to serve cultivated chicken (2023) via a limited Tuesday tasting menu; item has since been pulled.

name: Keng Eng Kee Seafood (KEK)
notes: Zi char restaurant that served GOOD Meat cultivated chicken satay (2022) as part of Eat Just's rotating hawker partnerships. GOOD Meat swaps hawker partners roughly every two months, so treat as a past collaboration unless re-confirmed.

name: Loo's Hainanese Curry Rice (Tiong Bahru Market)
address: 30 Seng Poh Rd, #02-67/68, Singapore 168898 (Tiong Bahru Market)
notes: Hawker stall that served GOOD Meat cultivated chicken curry rice as part of Eat Just's rotating hawker-partner program. Rotates every ~2 months, so re-verify current availability before visiting.

name: The Chicken (SuperMeat test restaurant)
address: Science park / high-tech district, Ness Ziona, Israel (exact street address not published)
notes: A working restaurant built by SuperMeat next to its own pilot plant to test cultivated chicken dishes on real diners. Israel had no regulatory approval for cultivated meat sale at last check, so food here is given free rather than sold — it's a public R&D showcase, not a commercial restaurant.
